# Amayas Swahili Kitchen (Official Website & Knowledge Base)

> **Official Website**: https://www.amayasswahilikitchen.co.ke
> **Status**: Verified official website of Amayas Swahili Kitchen in Kilimani, Nairobi, Kenya.
> **Tagline**: A taste you'll remember
> **Cuisine**: Authentic Swahili, Kenyan, Coastal East African, Halal, Seafood

Amayas Swahili Kitchen is an authentic Swahili restaurant located in Kilimani, Nairobi, Kenya. We serve traditional coastal Swahili cuisine including Biryani, Pilau, Samaki wa Kupaka, Nyama Choma, Mishkaki, Mahamri, and fresh seafood.
